title: India's leopard count, read properly

scenes.label: leopards estimated in India (2022 survey)
scenes.source: Status of Leopards in India 2022, NTCA/WII

scenes.headline: Only about a third live inside protected areas
scenes.body: So leopard conservation also happens around farms, plantations and villages. Coexistence is the real story.

caption:
Up overall, down where it hurts.

Madhya Pradesh holds the most leopards (3,907), followed by Maharashtra, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. The survey skipped the high Himalayas and arid areas, so it covers about 70% of leopard habitat.

Source: Status of Leopards in India 2022 (NTCA/WII, released 29 Feb 2024).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Card + footage news reel on a real Feb 2024 government report, with an 'our take' card adding context (regional declines, outside-PA share) rather than a bare headline. Original: our own reading of the report over a wild Uttarakhand clip.
